metadata.description: A personal collection of Claude Code skill plugins for API testing, JSON processing, and Obsidian note management.

plugins.name: bruno
plugins.description: Run API tests using Bruno CLI with environment management, test assertions, and report generation for automated API testing workflows.

plugins.name: jq
plugins.description: Extract and transform specific fields from JSON files and API responses using jq, without loading entire files into context.

plugins.name: obsidian-flashcard
plugins.description: Generate spaced-repetition flashcards in the Obsidian Spaced Repetition plugin format from notes and learning material.

plugins.name: obsidian-format
plugins.description: Reformat raw content into clean, Obsidian-compatible Markdown—fixing structure, headings, lists, tables, and frontmatter—without changing the wording.

plugins.name: obsidian-note-from-transcript
plugins.description: Turn a raw or timestamped transcript (video, lecture, podcast, meeting) into a concise, vault-native Obsidian note that matches the target vault's conventions.

plugins.name: obsidian-vault-lint
plugins.description: Health check for an Obsidian vault—scans notes for broken wikilinks, unclosed code fences, heading-level skips, malformed callouts, unknown tags, orphan notes, and house-rule conventions.
